compactRecord.td: Westernmost point of Japan, 125 km from Taiwan. Off the south coast at Arakawa-bana lies a 50 × 20 m sandstone formation with terraces, steps and right angles, discovered by divers in 1986 — disputed as natural pseudo-tectonic erosion vs. man-made mo
